description: List thermal clump information. By default, the thermal clump ID, temperature, and fixity condition are listed. Use the attribute keyword to list all thermal clump attributes.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: read the same data via itasca.clump.thermal object getters

keywords.name: attribute
keywords.description: List thermal clump attributes. If no s is given, then the available attributes are listed. If s is specified, then the value of that attribute is listed for each thermal clump. Attributes are characteristics of thermal clumps such as temperature and unbalpower. These are distinct from thermal pebble properties that represent surface conditions and are used in contact models to delineate interactions.

keywords.name: contact
keywords.description: List the contacts with a thermal clump. The contact ID, ID of the other contacting piece, contact type, activity state, inhibited state, and contact model are listed. By default, only active contacts are listed. Use the all keyword to list active and inactive contacts.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: List the extra variables at index i.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: List the group names at slot s.

keywords.name: property
keywords.description: List clump properties. If no s is given, then the available properties are listed for each thermal clump. If s is specified, then the value of that property is listed for each clump. Properties represent surface conditions and are used in contact models to delineate interactions. These are distinct from attributes, which are characteristics of thermal clumps such as temperature and unbalpower.

notes: Give the optional attribute name as a bare token (list attribute temperature); a quoted string is rejected live on all versions. 'list group' requires the group name string.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): list and the attribute, contact, extra, group and property sub-keywords executed on all six consoles.
